name: EN client escalation — contract at risk
transcript:
[00:00:05] Client: We need to talk about the system performance issues. This is completely unacceptable.
[00:00:12] Manager: I understand your frustration. Can you describe what you are experiencing?
[00:00:18] Client: The system has been down for three hours this morning. This is the second time this month. Our operations are completely blocked.
[00:00:28] Manager: I sincerely apologize. We are investigating the root cause right now.
[00:00:35] Client: This cannot continue. We have SLA commitments to our own clients. If this is not resolved by Friday, we will have to reconsider our contract with you.
[00:00:47] Manager: I completely understand. I will escalate this to our engineering director immediately. We will provide a written root cause analysis by Thursday.
[00:00:58] Client: Thursday is acceptable, but we also need a written commitment on the remediation plan and timeline. We cannot keep accepting verbal assurances.
[00:01:10] Manager: Absolutely. I will send both the root cause analysis and a written remediation commitment by Thursday end of day.
[00:01:18] Client: Good. We need to see this resolved permanently, not just patched temporarily.

summary: Client reported a three-hour system outage — the second incident this month — causing operational disruption.
Client threatened contract reconsideration if the issue is not resolved by Friday.
Manager committed to sending a written root cause analysis and remediation plan by Thursday end of day.

action_items.task: Send written remediation commitment and timeline
